purpose: Assistant-led HOA/community-association and multifamily portfolio-manager expansion. These are aggregated buyer accounts where one relationship may represent recurring work across multiple properties or associations.
safety: Inventory seed only. No outreach is staged or sent. Existing preferred-vendor relationships are assumed to exist; BMC should position as overflow, local-gap, emergency, specialty-bid or supplemental vendor depth unless the manager explicitly requests broader sourcing.
